description: Update repository description / visibility / default_branch. Requires 'admin' access on the repo (owner, org owners/admins, admin collaborators) and 'repo' scope. Returns {ok: true}.

automation.description: Per-repo automation dials, same keys as Settings → Automation: ai_review_mode, pr_triage_mode, issue_triage_mode, auto_merge_mode, ci_autofix_mode, auto_repair_mode, auto_issues_mode, doc_drift_mode. Values: off | suggest | auto. Only the keys given change.
